items.text: The precedent F-DME-NECESSITY does not apply because it addresses DME coverage under clause C-2026-DME-NECESSITY, not ambulance transport, so version drift prevents its use here.
The precedent F-ER-NECESSITY does not apply because it concerns emergency room coverage under clause C-2026-ER-COVERAGE, which is a different service line from ambulance transport.
The precedent F-PHYSIO-NECESSITY does not apply because it relates to physiotherapy limits under clause C-2026-PHYSIO-LIMIT, not the ambulance clause, resulting in version drift.
The precedent F-PHYSIO-NOTES does not apply because it also pertains to physiotherapy limits under clause C-2026-PHYSIO-LIMIT, which is unrelated to ambulance transport.
